item.title: Calais, Worcester residents will vote next week on whether to close their small elementary schools
item.description: School officials say closure will help strengthen educational programming at three other K-6 schools in the district, but residents fear closure will only exacerbate demographic decline in their small towns. item.title: Amid outcry, Montpelier council scraps proposal to gain veto power over citizen petitions
item.description: Feedback from residents was overwhelmingly against the proposed change to the charter. “I think it’s pretty anti-democratic and really flies in the face of our values as Americans and Vermonters,” councilor Cary Brown said. item.title: Proposed Senate bill would make plug-in solar easier to own
item.description: Under the bill, plug-in solar devices would no longer need an interconnection agreement, a contract between customer and utility which ensures technical compatibility when connecting a new energy system to an existing grid. item.title: Vermont nurses raise alarms about proposed federal loan limits
item.description: A federal rule proposed Friday would cap the amount of federal dollars nurses can borrow towards graduate level degrees. Vermont’s nurses say that can undermine an already strapped workforce. Read the story on VTDigger here: Vermont nurses raise alarms about proposed federal loan limits.
